reviewNotes: First-party ward list binds Id 3 to Phường Buôn Ma Thuột and the 2024 parcel-sheet note; source basename resolves to phuong_bmt_merged. Original 153,979,617-byte CRS84 GeoJSON has 82,935 Polygon features and one point-covering feature labeled 8(51). But OBJECTID has only 34,474 distinct values: 14,873 IDs are reused across 63,334 rows. OBJECTID 3216 occurs on seven geometrically different polygons. Thus the packet canonical ID is not unique and OBJECTID:3216 is not a safe parcel key. English and Vietnamese searches are visible in the worker search action. No retained durable sample polygon.
